summary: Complete print-ready study guide for Energy Conservation and Management (BE05019021) mid-sem exam covering all Tier 1, Tier 2, and key Tier 3 topics across 3 chapters. Contains 28 exam-ready Q&A entries including: EC Act 2001, BEE Schemes, Indian Energy Scenario, Energy Security, Classification of Energy, Energy Conservation importance, ECBC, Electricity Act 2003, NAPCC missions, Energy Pricing, Furnace fuel economy measures, Boiler efficiency (theory + full worked numerical), Steam traps, HVAC/Refrigeration conservation, Blow down, Boiler conservation opportunities, Furnace losses, Feed water treatment, CDM with project cycle, Bachat Lamp Yojna, UNFCCC, Kyoto Protocol, PCF, COP, Carbon Credit Trade Scheme, PAT Scheme, and Sustainable Development. Ends with a diagram section listing 4 drawings needed with Google search terms and drawing instructions.
